items.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
items.snippet: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it. Ghostscript is the interpreter that many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling it directly. items.title: Signal to block Siri, Gemini AI from capturing chats on iOS, Android
items.snippet: Signal has announced new protections that block screenshots on iOS 27 and prevent AI assistants from capturing conversations on supported Android devices. [...]
items.summary: Signal is introducing new privacy features to block screenshots on iOS and prevent assistants like Siri and Gemini from capturing chat content on Android. Update the Signal app on your mobile devices.

items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.snippet: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.
items.summary: OpenAI discusses how perplexity measures progress in AI models and why it helps establish shared evaluation approaches. Try it by integrating evaluation benchmarks into your AI workflows.

items.title: A Beginner's Guide to Local AI with Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth
items.summary: This guide explains how to run local AI models using Inkling, Qwen, and Unsloth. Developers interested in local AI can try these tools by downloading the open-weight models and running them locally.
